name: Mesmer
description:
You love and fear this part. You dangle the swinging weight by its chain in front of the Queen's delighted face. It's taken you months to gain the confidence of her retainers, to earn this level of access. Your showmanship has carried you this far, but now you have to rely on whatever strange magic lies within the mask you wear. Sometimes it feels like the mask is wearing you. In fact, you need one of those moments right now. The "hypnotism" technique is something you perfected in the streets of the market district all those years ago. What comes out of you when you perform it while wearing the mask is something else entirely. Sometimes you feel it coming, other times you're as surprised as anyone else. You have noticed that a particular cadence of pendulous motion seems to invite it, so you lock into that tempo carefully, even as soothing, beguiling words form softly on your lips. There: you feel a sharpness in the center of your forehead, in your fingertips. A light fills the monarch's eyes and her head tilts back suddenly. Her guards step forward but you reassure them with a confident, charismatic gesture. You turn back to her - you're not sure how or why, but she's now under your control. Her mind belongs to you, or rather, it belongs to you and the mask...

A Mesmer is a charlatan who is discovering that their techniques of suggestion and misdirection actually have some element of real magic within them. That magic is tied to the masks they wear - masks that require an act of will on the part of the wearer to remove, and which only give up their secrets when they choose to. The magic they contain allows a Mesmer to manipulate the mind, ensnare the senses, and even extend their own perception across great distances.

The Mesmer mestiere uses other people as a resource. Your abilities give you more direct control over the thoughts, actions and perceptions of others than anyone else in the game. But that control only comes as you untangle the strange mystery of the power contained within the masks you wear, which is governed by the Masked Charlatan ability. You will not have control over where and when these powers will emerge, but once they do, you'll be able to call upon them as you choose.

You'll find Mesmer's masks throughout the world. They are widely variable in their appearances and in the local traditions that surround them, but each mask adheres to one of five archetypes, each of which is bound to a skill, a domain of magic, and an area of mundane techniques that are associated with its emergent power:

  • Il Burattinaio, Mask of Strings is bound to Persuade. Its domain is Control. Its techniques include hypnotism, magnetic passes, confession, suggestion, and other methods of guiding thought, behavior, and will.

  • Il Sogno, Mask of Dreams is bound to the Insight skill. Its domain is Illusion. Its techniques include phantasmagoria, dream interpretation, mesmerism, and other methods of shaping perception, belief, and unreality.

  • Il Terrore, Mask of Dread is bound to the Awe skill. Its domain is Fear. Its techniques include memento mori, the evil eye, ominous prophecy, and other methods of instilling dread, unease, and mortal awareness.

  • Il Volto, Mask of Faces is bound to the Perform skill. Its domain is Identity. Its techniques include imitation, caricature, parody, melodrama, and other adjustments to voice, posture and demeanor.

  • L'Occhio, Mask of Eyes is bound to the Awareness skill. Its domain is Perception. Its techniques include scrying, augury, keen observation, and other methods of uncovering hidden truths, distant events, and unseen patterns.

Each mask, while worn, grants a +1 bonus to its associated skill, granting the wearer the benefits to social interaction that come with wearing something as strangely beguiling as a Mesmer's mask.

The Mesmer mestiere is a strange mix of uncertainty, discovery and - eventually - unparalleled control over those around you.

Play a Mesmer if you want to:

  • Reach into the unknown, discovering new and strange magical powers at unexpected moments, never quite certain where performance ends and a spell begins.

  • Manipulate others through magic and social interaction. Discover hidden truths and corners of reality that only exist in the minds of others.

  • Be mysterious, alluring, and a little frightening, an unsettling presence in any situation, influencing others and bending their perception to your will.

Questions to consider when making a Mesmer:

  • What draws them to the masks—concealment, craft, or the version of themselves the mask makes possible? Did they find or buy their first mask, or was it gifted to them?

  • How do they relate to the unpredictability of their discipline? Do they relish the surprise and delight, or do they find it maddening to not be in full control?

  • Have they ever encountered someone who genuinely couldn’t be charmed—who saw through their techniques right away? What did that teach them, and did it stick?

  • Where do they draw the line in manipulating others? A momentary charm is one thing; a compulsion that persists for a month is another.

  • Is there a place or time when the mask comes off? To what degree has the masked superseded their personal identity? Is that change still happening?

novizio.description: You have experience as a practitioner of mundane techniques of influence, misdirection and illusion, which you have used for personal profit - whether material or social. You have come into ownership of masks that contain a power you don't understand, and which has asserted itself unexpectedly during at least one of your performances.
novizio.abilities:
Masked Charlatan, Mesmerize, Social Savvy, Unsettling Presence.

Also choose any two Mesmer's Masks from this mestiere or from one of your home Cultures. You gain one ability chosen at random from each of those masks' domains.
novizio.spellcasting: To cast spells, you must be wearing a Mesmer's mask, and you must not be wearing any metal on your head.
novizio.gratuiti: Chained weights, magnets, mirrors, dream charts, cosmetics, or other small tools that enable your mundane techniques. A letter of recommendation from an eminent person you have entertained and/or influenced. Three changes of attire appropriate to different social situations.
